**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers.

Review owner record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4216#issuecomment-7224610644

## What looks good

- `step_budget_row.rs`: the label moves to its own line. The field still uses `labelled_by(l.id)`, so the AccessKit name of the field does not change.
- `tool_list_page.rs`: the gutter is calculated from `ui.spacing().scroll` (bar width plus the two margins). It is not a fixed pixel number.
- Each fix has a pinning test that uses real pointer and wheel events at 1280 x 720.
- The decision record `docs/decisions/1992-properties-reach.md` gives what was dropped and why.
- The body has before/after screenshots for the two changed pages. The four PNGs are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. No image or log is in the PR tree.
- No snapshot PNG changes. No new test binary. The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` goes up by one.
- The body ends with `Fixes #1992` and has a `Changelog:` line. The commit subject is a conventional `fix(ui):`.

## Results (locally, on wopr, trial merge with `upstream/main` 751a79b20)

The host has a software GPU adapter (llvmpipe via Vulkan). The UI suites ran on it.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 10 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (2.5 min) |
| `ui suites: lib` | 1767 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored |
| `ui suites`: boundary, boundary_picks, contour_dxf_sketch, sinker_setup, tap_hand, theme_example, theme_files, waterjet_tool | all ok |
| `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -- -D warnings` | clean |

Extra suites run: none were owed. The diff does not touch `testdata/`, a fixture or golden directory, or the import code.

Heavy lanes: the diff reaches none. Not run.

Safety tier: no. The diff changes only UI layout and UI tests. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. No golden moved.

## Mutations (by the reviewer)

I put back the `upstream/main` copy of `step_budget_row.rs` and `tool_list_page.rs`, and ran the three pinning tests:

- `layout_page_model`: red. `Model page: "Set" [[1252.0 248.5] - [1278.9 266.5]] leaves the Properties leaf [[990.0 104.0] - [1264.0 682.0]] across`.
- `a_centre_click_on_edit_opens_the_tool_after_a_scroll_across`: red. `left: SetupNode("Setup1", Tools)`, `right: Tool("EM-0600-4FL")`.
- `layout_page_operation`: green, as the body says (it only adds an anchor).

With the PR files restored, the three tests are green. The failure text agrees with the body.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/page_layout.rs` is now 405 lines (it was 403). This is a test file that was already near the limit. A split can be a later `P7` item.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
